fact: Algeria's Ministry of Interior says that since 2018 the NIN is generated automatically from the civil register (RNAEC) when a birth is registered.
The Interior minister said his ministry has a central role in citizens' legal identity through both the civil register (etat civil) and the issue of identity documents.
system: Interior ministry civil status and identity documents

fact: The Ministry of the Interior says the central biometric document issuance system is connected to the national civil register (RNEC) and to AFIS, with the national identification number (NIN) as the key between the databases.
